Arrange the components of a comprehensive 15-minute national radio bulletin in standard production order:
(I) Opening station signature tune and time check
(II) Headline summary of the 4-5 major stories
(III) Detailed dispatches on top national political and governance stories
(IV) International news, business round-up, and sports roundup
(V) Recap of main headlines and sign-off

Choose the correct chronological/logical sequence from the options given below:

options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

Correct answer. Accurately identifies the verified NCERT concept for Radio News Bulletin Rundown.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT principles for Radio and Cinema (Radio News Bulletin Rundown):
I -> II -> III -> IV -> V

Detailed Context:
Bulletin rundown: Signature/time -> Headlines -> Top national stories -> International/business/sports -> Headline recap/sign-off.
Hence Option D is correct.

Therefore, option (D) is the correct answer.
